evidence_method.executable: Static PE data and instruction analysis against preferred image base 0x00400000.
evidence_method.level_metadata: Length-prefixed metadata fields in each original LVD, checked against archive member hashes.
evidence_method.parser_limit: The supplied parser exposes raw bytes but its semantic LVD labels conflict with valid length-prefixed metadata. Its labels were not copied.
evidence_method.profiling_limit: No dynamic instrumentation was used. Source bytes without a reachable finite-product consumer remain lossless evidence-only data; current runtime semantics come only from pinned static producers and consumers.

shop_cadence.evidence: The manual states that every fourth level has a shop.

level_boundary.playable_content_policy: Levels 1-100 use losslessly decoded LVD authored logic plus explicit executable-backed v9 runtime contracts. Legacy waves remain readable scaffolding and cannot alter current authoritative play.

movement_interpretation.confirmed: The primary and secondary tables participate in projectile movement setup.
movement_interpretation.normalization: For the playable content, primary movement is converted to 16.16 vertical velocity and ordinary secondary values in the range -2 through 2 are converted to horizontal velocity.
movement_interpretation.special_encodings: War.I.Plasma values 163 and 165 produce time-scaled random horizontal velocity; Fireballs values 190 and 200 produce one-time time-scaled spawn-X jitter followed by zero horizontal velocity. Exact arithmetic, float32 endpoint behavior, allocation, update, and collision ordering are pinned in weapon_runtime.json.

weapons.manual_conflict: Some presentation text describes Super Triple as five-times damage; the executable table stores exactly 4.0.

difficulties.runtime_contracts: Executable-backed simulation scales, timer adjustments/floors, projectile and player speeds, timed-effect durations, Extra Time floors, and falling-bonus drop denominators are represented as deterministic rational/integer server values.
difficulties.playable_content_policy: content/difficulties.json contains only consumer-backed retail behavior or explicit deterministic rational normalization; it does not fabricate a cash multiplier.

asset_notes.hma_format: For the inspected matching sprites, HMA contains exactly one byte per image pixel with observed values 0 and 1.
asset_notes.attack_path_usage: The executable globally compacts all 14 SWDs and state 2 selects from that catalog; the traced load and selection paths prove there is no per-LVD SWD assignment.

bonus_mode_voice_files.executable_binding: Meteor gem pickup ordinary announcement at 0x005ffb14-0x005ffb23
Meteor Gem Drop threshold announcements at 0x005fea82, 0x005ff133, and 0x005ff7b4

gem_drop_controller_assets.executable_binding: State-18 Gem Drop music switch at 0x005f8f30-0x005f8f96

voice_pack.summary: The bundled notice reserves all rights, limits the voice packs to Warblade, and prohibits copying, redistribution, and modification.
voice_pack.pipeline_action: Voice-pack directories remain excluded except for executable-referenced first-ten, Memory Station, Meteor Storm (including bonus and gemdrop), malfunction, and rank-1-through-20 cues copied only for the user-requested local Warblade remake.
